newsitem.title: USA: Insituform resets meeting, dissidents seek 3 seats.
newsitem.headline: Insituform resets meeting, dissidents seek 3 seats.

text.p: Insituform Technologies Inc said Monday it had rescheduled its annual meting to August 21 from July 15.
It said it made the move because more time is needed to find a candidate to replace director Douglas Chick, who has retired, and to provide shareholders with information.

Insituform, a sewer, water, gas and industrial pipe repair company, said it had learned that two dissident directors, Jerome Kalishman and Robert Affholder, have launched a proxy contest to replace three directors.
"The dissident proposal has created a major distraction for Insituform's management at a time whren the company is already undergoing major restructuring in order to improve profitability," it said.
The company said it is continuing with the consolidation of its headquarters, engineering, research and contracting management functions, now located in Memphis and St. Louis.
It is simultaneously restructuring company operations, which will include "significant" staff reductions, it said.
